parts.text: I don't know what I need to know immediately when something goes wrong. I do worry about things happening outside our control, like closures coming into force or being amended while drones are already in the air, and batteries draining faster in cold and wind than planned. Radio coverage can also be patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, causing reports from drones to arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all.
